_form: Form 8949 - Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets
_notes: Page 1 = Part I (Short-Term), Page 2 = Part II (Long-Term). 11 transaction rows per part, 8 columns each. Boxes A-C/G-I for ST, D-F/J-L for LT. Adjustment codes: B=basis incorrect, W=wash sale.
